scope: Apple ARM64 host hash selection; no iPhone/gameplay performance claim
decision: Reject every new hash/lane/tuning candidate; preserve the existing production hash byte-for-byte
methodNotes: All bytes remain hashed; block scrambles, final stripe, seed/secret behavior and output are preserved.
Final wall ratios pair each candidate with its baseline in the same round. Ratio below one means less time.
Final twelve-round Williams design balances treatment positions and predecessors. Each trial hashes 4GiB.
64MiB streaming is a larger working set, not a guarantee of a cold hardware cache.
p10/p90 describe trial dispersion, not confidence intervals. Different runs are not pooled or compared as before/after gameplay.
The final LLVM22 run shares the Core CPU/ISA flags; tuned6 changes scheduling only via per-TU -mtune=apple-m1. macOS host execution still differs from iPhone.
Thread CPU time is companion evidence for scheduling noise; it does not replace the wall-time improvement criterion.
ASan exact-sized allocations check the input buffer boundary. Secret storage is a 256-byte array even for shorter logical secrets.
